tieu_de: Senior AI Native Engineer React, Next.js, Flutter
mo_ta_cong_viec:
DatVietVAC Group Holdings is looking for a Senior AI Native Engineer (React, Next.js, Flutter) to build web and mobile applications for our Fan Commerce Platform.
You will develop web applications using React and Next.js and cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter for Android and iOS. This role follows an AI-native development approach, using coding agents and AI-assisted tools to accelerate delivery while maintaining high standards of code quality, security, performance, and maintainability in production.1. Web and Mobile Application Development
Build and maintain web applications using React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
Develop cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter and Dart for Android and iOS.
Deliver product features from UI/UX designs and product requirements through development, testing, release, and production support.
Translate product requirements and designs into well-structured, testable, and production-ready code.
Develop core user journeys across web and mobile, ensuring a consistent experience across platforms.
Build responsive, accessible, and high-performing interfaces for different devices and network conditions.
Optimize application performance, stability, loading time, and overall user experience.2. AI-native and Coding Agent Development
Use coding agents and AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or equivalent solutions for code generation, refactoring, debugging, documentation, and repetitive engineering tasks.
Design effective prompts, context, rules, and development workflows so that coding agents produce code aligned with product requirements, project architecture, and engineering conventions.
Review, test, correct, and improve AI-generated code before merging or releasing it.
Identify security, performance, maintainability, and architectural risks in AI-generated code.
Balance development speed with code quality, testing coverage, maintainability, and long-term product stability.
Evaluate new AI-assisted engineering tools and recommend practical applications for the development team.3. System Integration and Product Quality
Integrate web and mobile applications with backend services through REST or gRPC APIs.
Implement authentication, authorization, state management, error handling, and end-to-end data flows.
Write and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests for core product journeys.
Debug application issues and identify root causes across frontend, mobile, API, and integration layers.
Participate in code reviews, CI/CD pipelines, release processes, and production troubleshooting.
Ensure stable user experiences across supported browsers, operating systems, devices, and screen sizes.
Collaborate with QC Engineers to define test scenarios and resolve issues before release.4. Engineering Standards and Collaboration
Develop and share best practices, reusable prompts, templates, and guidelines for coding-agent-assisted development.
Contribute to frontend and mobile architecture, coding standards, reusable components, and shared libraries.
Collaborate closely with Product Owners, UX/UI Designers, Backend Engineers, QC Engineers, and SRE/DevOps Engineers throughout the product development lifecycle.
Communicate technical decisions, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs clearly to relevant stakeholders.
Mentor team members on the effective and responsible use of coding agents.
Continuously improve development workflows, code quality, engineering productivity, and release efficiency.
yeu_cau:
Education
College or bachelor’s degree in information technology, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.Experience
At least four years of experience as a Frontend Engineer, Mobile Engineer, Full-stack Engineer, or in a similar software engineering role.
Proven experience delivering React or Next.js web applications and Flutter mobile applications to production.
Practical experience using coding agents or AI-assisted development tools in day-to-day software development.
Experience developing transactional products involving payments, e-commerce, fintech, or high-traffic applications is highly preferred.Technical Knowledge and Skills
Strong proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, React, and Next.js.
Good understanding of server-side rendering, static-site generation, routing, state management, responsive design, and frontend performance optimization.
Strong proficiency in Flutter and Dart for developing cross-platform mobile applications for Android and iOS.
Good understanding of Flutter widget architecture, state management, application lifecycle, build configuration, and release processes.
Experience publishing or supporting applications on the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
Hands-on experience with coding agents such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or equivalent tools.
Ability to manage prompts, context, rules, and workflows and to critically review AI-generated code.
Strong understanding of component architecture, reusable code, debugging, error handling, and application performance.
Experience writing unit, integration, and end-to-end tests using tools such as Jest, Playwright, and Flutter Test.
Experience integrating REST or gRPC APIs and implementing authentication and authorization flows.
Understanding of Git workflows, code reviews, CI/CD, and Agile/Scrum development practices.Tech Stack

Web: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS

Strong communication and collaboration skills when working with Product, UX/UI, Backend, QC, and SRE/DevOps teams.
Proactive, self-directed, and comfortable working in a new product environment.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs clearly.Language Skills

Basic English communication skills or above.Nice to Have

Experience creating or maintaining a Design System, component library, or shared UI framework.

Knowledge of frontend and mobile security best practices.
Experience monitoring and optimizing application performance in production.
